description: Diagnostic module to investigate why permission_scope, temporal_stability, and tool_description_safety signals show only 3 distinct values each (range 30-100, 40-90, 50-100). Must analyze metadata inputs fed to each enrichment and identify bucket collapse. Reads: permission_scope_enrichment.py, temporal_stability_enrichment.py, tool_description_safety_enrichment.py. Outputs diagnosis report identifying which metadata field combinations produce identical scores.
